errors.evidence: The figure and its title only use the abbreviation "HCI". Expanding this to "Human Capital Index" is an interpretation based on external knowledge, not information explicitly provided in the image.

This statement oversimplifies the trend between 2012 and 2016. It omits the data point for 2014, where the value drops significantly to just under 0.80. The actual trend is a sharp drop from 2012 (approx. 0.85) to 2014 (approx. 0.796), followed by a smaller drop to the minimum in 2016 (approx. 0.788). The description incorrectly merges this into a single movement, misrepresenting the shape of the line.
